name: FSSAI Central Food License
description: Mandatory central statutory food license for food manufacturing enterprises with annual turnover exceeding 20 Crore INR.

required_documents: Form B (Application for Central License)
Food Safety Management System (FSMS) Plan or Certificate
Blueprint / Layout plan of the processing unit showing dimensions and area allocation
List of equipment and machinery with installed capacity and horsepower
List of food categories and product formulations desired to be manufactured
Water potability analysis report (chemical and bacteriological) from NABL-accredited lab
Proof of possession of premises (Sale deed / Registered lease agreement)
Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed and list of directors
application_steps: Create an account on the FoSCoS portal (https://foscos.fssai.gov.in)
Select 'Apply for New License' and choose 'Central Licensing'
Select Food Manufacturing category and applicable food codes
Upload mandatory premises blueprint, FSMS plan, water analysis report, and machinery list
Pay statutory fee of ₹7,500 per year online
Central Licensing Authority conducts technical scrutiny and pre-licensing inspection
Address any scrutiny clarifications within 30 days
Download digitally signed 14-digit Central Food License

name: Legal Metrology Packaged Commodities Registration (Rule 27)
description: Mandatory statutory registration for manufacturers and pre-packers under Rule 27 of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011.

metadata.validity_period: Lifetime (unless change in premises or packaging lines)
required_documents: Application in prescribed Form under Rule 27
Specimen artwork / label of packaged commodities showing mandatory declarations (MRP, net weight, ingredients, FSSAI logo)
Proof of factory / packaging premises ownership or registered lease agreement
Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed
GST Registration Certificate
List of pre-packaged commodities and standard pack sizes
application_steps: Access National Single Window System (NSWS) or Central Legal Metrology Portal
Fill Application under Rule 27 for registration as Manufacturer / Pre-Packer
Upload sample package label artwork with required statutory declarations
Pay one-time statutory registration fee of ₹500
Controller / Director of Legal Metrology issues Registration Certificate within 7 days
metadata.portal_name: National Single Window System / Legal Metrology Portal (LMPC)

name: CPCB Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) for Plastic Packaging
description: Mandatory Extended Producer Responsibility registration on CPCB centralized portal for Brand Owners and Manufacturers utilizing plastic packaging.

metadata.statutory_fee: ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 based on plastic consumption volume
metadata.validity_period: 1 year initial registration, renewable for 3 years
required_documents: Entity PAN, GST, and Company Incorporation Certificate
State Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish (CTE) / Operate (CTO)
Category-wise plastic packaging procurement breakdown (Cat I Rigid, Cat II Flexible, Cat III Multi-layered)
EPR action plan and engagement agreement with registered Plastic Waste Processors (PWPs)
Declaration of post-consumer plastic waste collection mechanism
application_steps: Register company account on CPCB Centralized EPR Portal (https://eprplastic.cpcb.gov.in)
Select Brand Owner (PIBO) classification
Submit annual quantity of plastic packaging introduced into the market by category
Upload SPCB CTE/CTO and CA-certified packaging consumption figures
Pay statutory registration processing fee online
CPCB divisional officer verifies application and grants EPR Registration Certificate
metadata.portal_name: CPCB Centralized EPR Portal for Plastic Packaging

name: Jaivik Bharat / NPOP Organic Food Certification
description: Statutory organic endorsement under FSS (Organic Foods) Regulations, 2017 for food business operators making organic claims.

metadata.statutory_fee: Endorsement integrated with FoSCoS; accredited certification body fee applies
metadata.validity_period: Co-terminus with FSSAI license / NPOP Scope Certificate (annual)
required_documents: Valid NPOP Scope Certificate from an APEDA-accredited certification body or PGS-India Certificate
Supply chain traceability and organic raw material procurement invoices
Organic Production and Handling System Plan (OSP)
Product packaging artwork featuring the official 'Jaivik Bharat' logo and certification code
application_steps: Engage accredited certification body for processing inspection and obtain NPOP Scope Certificate
Log in to FoSCoS portal and apply for Organic Food Endorsement
Upload Scope Certificate, Organic System Plan, and product label artwork with Jaivik Bharat logo
FSSAI Designated Officer approves organic endorsement for the declared product lines
metadata.portal_name: Jaivik Bharat / FoSCoS Organic Food Portal
